blocks.html:
There are essentially three phases during the semester when the Student Council makes and publishes its decisions.

These phases are preceded by the proposal period when the associations submit their proposals, and are followed by the various steps of the Student Referendum process.

Other important dates each semester are the first and last days of the period during which Student Initiatives can be launched.

items.title: Student Corporation Calendar - Autumn semester 2026
items.html:
When

What

31 August

Submission of the project proposal phase.
Recognized student associations can start submitting proposals to the Student Council.
All students can submit an idea.

Student Initiative phase opens
Students may now begin to launch Student Initiatives.

4 October

The proposal phase ends for Student associations
After this date, student associations can no longer submit proposals to the Student Council for the semest

4 October

The student Initiative phase closes
After this date, Student initiatives can no longer be submitted for the semester.

22 ottobre

Student Council decisions
Publication of the decisions package for the semester in the List of Decisions, regarding the proposals received and its projects. There is a 15-day window to launch opposing Student Referendums.

22-24 ottobre

(Potential) vote on any decisions subject to mandatory Student Referendum
The Student General Assembly (all USI Bachelor's and Master's students) votes on any decisions made by the Student Council that are subject to mandatory Student Referendum

7 Novembre

First deadline for opposing Student Referendums
After this date, Student Referendums can no longer be launched against the decisions. Any Referendums are published in the List of Referendums and signatures can start to be collected.

27 novembre

Second deadline for opposing Student Referendums
By this date, 230 signatures must have been gathered for any Student Referendums launched against Student Council decisions. Any Referendum that has garnered 230 signatures will be put to the vote.

16-18 dicembre

(Potential) vote on opposing Student Referendums
The Student General Assembly (all USI Bachelor's and Master's students) votes on any Student Referendums against Student Council decisions which garnered 230 signatures by the deadline.

Note 1: Student Initiatives
Unlike Student Referendums, Student Initiatives are not linked to the decisions of the Student Council. The deadlines for collecting endorsements start from the moment the Initiative is published on the Initiatives Sheet. A Student Initiative, once published on the Initiatives Sheet, has 40 days to collect 230 endorsements; if successful, it is normally submitted to the vote of the General Student Assembly within 30 days following the end of the collection period.

Note 2: Oppositive Student Referendums
Oppositive Student Referendums can be launched by students against specific decisions of the Student Council.
To be submitted for voting, they must collect 230 endorsements within the established deadline. They are linked to the decisions contained in the Spring Semester Package (see Decisions Sheet).

Note 3: Mandatory Student Referendums
Mandatory Student Referendums are triggered automatically for certain decisions of the Student Council as provided by the Statute and regulations.

items.title: Student Corporation Calendar - Spring semester 2026
items.html:
What

When

2 February

Submission of the project proposal phase.
Recognized student associations can start submitting proposals to the Student Council.
All students can submit an idea.

Student Initiative phase opens
Students may now begin to launch Student Initiatives.

1 March

The proposal phase ends for associations
After this date, student associations can no longer submit proposals to the Student Council for the semester.

20 March

The student Initiative phase closes
After this date, Student initiatives can no longer be submitted for the semester.

26 March

Student Council Semester Decisions
Publication of the decisions on the List of Decisions concerning the package of proposals submitted to the Student Council and its own projects. A 15-day deadline begins for launching any Student Referendums against these decisions.

9 April

First deadline for opposing Student Referendums
After this date, Student Referendums can no longer be launched against the Decisions. Any Referendums are published in the List of Referendums and signatures can start to be collected.

14-16 April

(Potential) vote on any decisions subject to mandatory Student Referendum
The Student General Assembly (all USI Bachelor's and Master's students) votes on any decisions made by the Student Council that are subject to mandatory Student Referendum.

1 May

Second deadline for opposing Student Referendums
By this date, 230 signatures must have been gathered for any Student Referendums launched against Student Council decisions in. Any Referendum that has garnered 230 signatures will be put to the vote.

20-22 May

(Potential) vote on opposing Student Referendums
The Student General Assembly (all USI Bachelor's and Master's students) votes on any Student Referendums against the Student Council decisions, which garnered 230 signatures by the deadline.
